prompts.text: Explain in two short sentences why the sky appears blue.
日本語で、朝の散歩の利点を二つ挙げてください。
Write a Python function that returns the larger of two integers.

cli_format: Explicit identity Jinja template: raw prompt text only, no role delimiters or thinking prefix. Use raw-template.jinja on both CPU and Metal.
fallback_reference_format: The standalone pinned llama API capture uses identical raw text, add_special=true, parse_special=true; exact input ids and all pre-greedy logits are saved. This is a diagnostic workload, not default chat-template quality.
other_prompts: japanese and code are additional correctness captures, not included in the throughput median
